sources.title: GitHub - hansaprem/trievo-clinical-ner
sources.snippet: An end-to-end, high-performance Clinical Named Entity Recognition (NER) system engineered from scratch for clinical free-text entity extraction. TriEvo extracts pharmacological agents (CHEMICAL_DRUG) and pathological conditions/symptoms (DISEASE_PROBLEM) with verified character offsets and authentic model confidence scores.

sources.title: PubMedBERT: Open-Source Biomedical AI Model for Medical NLP | ExploreAI ...
sources.snippet: PubMedBERT is designed for biomedical natural language processing tasks including medical named entity recognition, question answering, and classification of healthcare texts. Is PubMedBERT open source? + Yes, PubMedBERT is an open-source model available for community development and implementation in biomedical NLP applications.
